34.source_text: And it came to pass that w hen he had thus spoken, all the multitude, with one accord, did go forth with their sick, and their afflicted, and their lame, and w ith their blind, and with their dumb, and with all they that were afflicted in any manner, and he did heal them every one as they were brought forth unto him ; and they did all, both they who had been healed and they who were whole, bow…
